comparison.objective: Finish four threaded inserts by tang removal; record locates a hidden wall screw with a magnetic stud finder.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs coaxial impact work and fragment recovery; record scans a surface while maintaining flat contact and senses magnetic capture before release.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contact fractures, contained tangs, and undamaged inserts/shell; record requires the finder hanging stably with a magnet within 10 mm of a hidden screw. Candidate numeric fracture limits are absent.
comparison.reason: Search by magnetic interaction and stable hanging test a different ability from controlled mechanical fracture.
